ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which bird has the longest beak?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image has four bird heads, labeled B (upper left), D (upper right), C (lower left), and A (lower right), respectively. Each bird's beak is a pointed part extending outward from the face. B's beak is relatively short, D's beak is curved but not as long as C's, and A's beak is also relatively short. C's beak extends very far to the left from the head, clearly exceeding the other three birds. Then reason: Comparing the extension distance of the four bird beaks from the head to the tip, C's beak is the longest. Therefore the answer is Bird C.
